biggest_catch: Only the first to identify a new vulnerability earns — duplicates and already-known bugs pay nothing.
catches: Only the first to identify a new vulnerability earns an award — duplicates earn nothing.
Requires real security expertise: qualifying vulnerabilities take skill and often many hours to find.
Coordinated disclosure is mandatory — you must report privately and follow the Rules of Engagement.
Responsible testing only: never access, modify, or exfiltrate customer data; never disrupt services.
Awards vary by program and severity — most hunters earn nothing per report.

steps: Review the active bounty programs and scope on the official MSRC bounty page.
Research vulnerabilities while working within the Rules of Engagement — no customer data access, no service disruption.
Report privately via the MSRC with clear reproduction steps, proof-of-concept code, and impact analysis.
MSRC triages the report; eligible first-reports earn awards based on program and severity.
timing: Reports are triaged continuously; awards are paid after the report is validated.
when_cash_arrives: Awards up to $250,000 are paid after your report is validated — triage is continuous but validation and payout take weeks.
maximize: Submit complete, reproducible reports on high-severity targets; validation speed depends on report quality.
